lines: Hiii! Oh my gosh, hi! I love your face. I love this town. I love EVERYTHING.
I'm Nina! Well, a Nina. The pond kind of... spat me out. It does that, after a rumble.
{player}: You're Nina? You don't look like Nina. Nina has a red bob and a bow.
Ugh, HER. Red bow, black turtleneck, so sensible. I've got freckles. And a much better hat.
(She smiles a big, sweet smile. It doesn't quite reach her eyes.)
Anyway! I'm going to go and have a little look around. Byeee!
Tangled lights? Mud pies? A sign that says TOWN SMELL? Gosh, that's terrible. Who would do something like that?
(She giggles, and quickly turns it into a cough.)
Going to tell on me? To HER? Go on, then. She won't believe you. Nobody believes the sensible one about anything fun.
Oh. It's you. And you told her, didn't you. I can tell.

choice.text: Why are you being so mean?
lines: Mean? Where I come from, everyone does tricks. Being sweet on the outside is how you win.
...Nobody where I come from ever asked me that before.

choice.text: You can't stay here and spoil things.
lines: Spoil things? I made your boring town INTERESTING.
(She folds her arms. For a second she looks a bit lonely.)
Fine. Your town's too nice anyway. Everyone's so... happy. It's weird.
But ponds work both ways, you know. Every time the ground rumbles.
See you around, {player}. Tell Nina I said hi. Actually, don't. Actually, do.
(She steps backwards off the bank, and the lilac water swallows her up without even a ripple.)
Hiii! (She waves a little too sweetly.)
